_comment: The human gate. This file stands in for whatever your organisation already
uses -- a change record, a ticket, a signed entry in a control system. What
matters is not the format. What matters is that the agent reads it, that a
person other than the one running the agent created the entry, and that the
approval is bound to a specific prompt version and expires.
Editing SYSTEM in agent.py without bumping PROMPT_VERSION and adding a new
approval here means the next --live run refuses. That is the point.

approvals.notes: Shadow run of 2026-03-27 reviewed against manual keying. One low-confidence scan routed to review as expected.
Superseded. Kept here so an expired, stale-prompt approval is something you can actually try: --approval CHG-2026-0288 is refused twice over.
